Subject: Vantorre CX-10 refurbished: repeated E34 lockouts and low core probe within 6 weeks

We bought this unit (order CM-88213) and it was delivered and commissioned at our Fitzroy kitchen on 14 Sept 2026. Facts below, in order.

Steam generator: the unit's error log shows E34 (low water level) nine times since 14 Sept (service report SR-1190). Kelsall attended on 22 Sept, replaced the water level sensor and passed three steam cycles. E34 came back four times in the week to 3 Oct. On Sat 24 Oct it locked out at 6.10pm with a full book of 60 covers. We finished the lamb on the stove and deck oven and had to 86 the pork belly.

Core probe: on 3 Oct we tested it against our Thermapen in a lamb shoulder. The oven read 63°C and the Thermapen 70°C. We repeated the test twice with the same result. It was recalibrated on 6 Oct (SR-1236) and the technician reported it within 1 degree.

Scale and water: on 6 Oct the steam generator was found heavily scaled, and we were advised to install a water softener because of hard supply. The unit was about three weeks old at that point. Our water supplier gives an average hardness for the Fitzroy supply of about 15 mg/L as CaCO3, which they describe as soft. We can't reconcile that with a site water problem, so before anyone buys on that basis, the seller should explain the scale finding.

Warranty: the 27 Oct callout (E34 again, further scale found) was invoiced at $308 inc GST as a site water issue, not covered. The warranty is registered to 14 March 2027, so check the terms on water-related faults before you buy.

Dion attended each visit and was easy to deal with.

reasons: It says the probe test was repeated twice, rather than done twice in total, and that the callout was invoiced rather than would be invoiced.
